title: We can’t just change the definition of ‘recording’
summary: With AI hardware, tech companies are pushing the definition of what does and doesn't constitute a recording. For most of gadget history, it'd be reasonable to assume that a device with a microphone or camera is either recording you or it isn't; it's either on or off, without much
reason: Opinion column about AI hardware and the definition of 'recording'. No named model release, no research artifact, no business event, no policy action, and no OSS tool; no active rule covers it.
